facts.statement: Linheraptor is a dromaeosaurid dinosaur that lived in what is now China during the Late Cretaceous.
facts.quote: Linheraptor is a genus of dromaeosaurid dinosaur which lived in what is now China in the Late Cretaceous.

facts.statement: The genus Linheraptor was named by Xu Xing and colleagues in 2010 and contains the single species Linheraptor exquisitus.
facts.quote: It was named by Xu Xing and colleagues in 2010, and contains the species Linheraptor exquisitus.

facts.statement: Linheraptor was a bird-like dinosaur found in Inner Mongolia that measured less than 2 meters (6.5 feet) in length.
facts.quote: This bird-like dinosaur was less than 2 m (6.5 ft) long and was found in Inner Mongolia.

facts.statement: A nearly complete fossilized skeleton of Linheraptor was found in 2008 by Jonah N. Choiniere and Michael Pittman in Inner Mongolia.
facts.quote: Researchers announced the discovery of the genus after a nearly complete fossilised skeleton was found in 2008 by Jonah N. Choiniere and Michael Pittman in Inner Mongolia

facts.statement: The Linheraptor specimen was recovered from the Wulansuhai Formation at Bayan Mandahu.
facts.quote: The specimen was recovered from rocks at Bayan Mandahu that belong to the Wulansuhai Formation.

facts.statement: The genus name Linheraptor refers to the Linhe district in Inner Mongolia, while the species name exquisitus refers to the excellent preservation of the holotype specimen IVPP V 16923.
facts.quote: The name of the genus refers to the district of Linhe, Inner Mongolia, China where the specimen was discovered, while the specific name, exquisitus, refers to the well-preserved nature of the holotype (IVPP V 16923).

facts.statement: Linheraptor was a bird-like theropod dromaeosaurid measuring approximately 1.8 meters in length and weighing up to 25 kilograms.
facts.quote: Linheraptor was a bird-like theropod dinosaur. It was a dromaeosaurid which measured approximately 1.8 m in length, and weighed up to approximately 25 kg.

facts.statement: At its size, Linheraptor was likely a fast and agile predator that may have preyed on small ceratopsians.
facts.quote: At that size, Linheraptor would have been a fast and agile predator, perhaps preying on small ceratopsians.

facts.statement: Like other dromaeosaurids, Linheraptor had an elongated skull, curved neck, enlarged toe claws, and a long tail, and it was a bipedal carnivore.
facts.quote: Like all dromaeosaurids, it had an elongated skull, a curved neck, an enlarged toe claw on each foot, and a long tail; Linheraptor was bipedal and carnivorous.

facts.statement: Researchers suggest the large toe claws of Linheraptor may have been used for capturing prey.
facts.quote: The large toe claws may have been used for capturing prey.

facts.statement: Linheraptor and Tsaagan are considered intermediate forms between basal and derived dromaeosaurids.
facts.quote: Linheraptor and Tsaagan were intermediate between basal and derived dromaeosaurids.

facts.statement: It is debated whether Linheraptor exquisitus is a junior synonym of Tsaagan mangas; some researchers argue for synonymy while others reject it based on anatomical details.
facts.quote: Senter (2011) and Turner, Makovicky and Norell (2012) argue that Linheraptor exquisitus is a junior synonym of Tsaagan mangas, but Xu, Pittman et al. (2015) reject this synonymy by responding to the counterarguments proposed using new and existing details of Linheraptors anatomy.

facts.statement: Linheraptor lived during the Late Cretaceous, approximately 75 million years ago in the Campanian stage, in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Cretácico,hace aproximadamente 75 millones de años durante el Campaniense, en lo que es hoy Asia.

facts.statement: Linheraptor is classified within the family Dromaeosauridae and the subfamily Velociraptorinae.
The fossil record for Linheraptor spans the Campanian age, from 83.6 to 72.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Campanian (83.6 to 72.2 million years ago)

rejected.statement: The holotype specimen of Linheraptor is one of the few nearly complete skeletons of dromaeosaurid dinosaurs known worldwide.
rejected.quote: The holotype specimen of Linheraptor, articulated and uncompressed, is one of the few nearly complete skeletons of dromaeosaurid dinosaurs worldwide.

rejected.statement: Linheraptor is believed to be most closely related to the dromaeosaurid Tsaagan mangas.
rejected.quote: Among its sister taxa, Linheraptor is believed to be most closely related to Tsaagan mangas.
